description_en: Creates a sub-enterprise for a group-type enterprise customer
description_zh: 调用本接口，可以实现为集团型的企业客户创建子企业
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen create-sub-corp --user-id 123 --outer-corp-id corp123 --outer-corp-name '测试企业' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSubCorp

parameters.help_en: The employee ID that exists in an enterprise that has signed the Alibaba Business Travel Parent Account Agreement
parameters.help_zh: 存在于已签署《阿里商旅主账号协议》的企业的员工 ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the sub-enterprise created through this operation. Reusing this ID causes the call to fail
parameters.help_zh: 通过本接口建立的子企业唯一 ID，重复使用时将导致调用失败
parameters.name: outer_corp_id

parameters.help_en: The unique name of the sub-enterprise created through this operation. Reusing this name causes the call to fail
parameters.help_zh: 通过本接口创建的子企业唯一名称，重复使用时将会导致调用失败
parameters.name: outer_corp_name

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise Access Token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending to the URL, use `crop_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 `crop_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

code.description_en: The error code. A non-zero value indicates that the request failed
code.description_zh: 错误码，非 0 时，表示请求失败

message.description_en: The failure reason. This parameter is returned only when the request fails
message.description_zh: 请求失败原因，仅请求失败时有值
message.example: 该企业不是已签署主子账户协议的主企业，不可创建子企业！

module.description_en: The response data. This parameter is returned only when the call succeeds
module.description_zh: 返回数据，仅调用成功时显示

sub_corp_id.description_en: The unique identifier automatically generated by Alibaba Business Travel when the sub-enterprise is successfully created
sub_corp_id.description_zh: 成功创建的子企业时，阿里商旅自动生成的唯一标识

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题的排查定位
